source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps both women by name and the dwelling metaphor across generations.
key_decisions.before: I am reminded of the sincere trust that is in you, which lived first in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice and, I am convinced, lives in you too.
key_decisions.after: I am reminded of your sincere faith, which first lived in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice and, I am convinced, lives in you as well.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: remembering your sincere faith, which first dwelt in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice, and now, I am convinced, dwells in you as well.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the contrast and all three positive qualities.
key_decisions.before: For God did not give us a spirit of cowardice but of power, love, and self-control.
key_decisions.after: For God did not give us a spirit of cowardice, but of power, love and self-control.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: for God gave us not a spirit of fear, but of power and love and self-control.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps imprisonment, shared suffering and divine capacity.
key_decisions.before: Therefore do not be ashamed of the testimony about our Lord or of me, his prisoner. Instead, share in suffering for the good news according to God’s power,
key_decisions.after: So do not be ashamed of the testimony about our Lord or of me, his prisoner. Instead, share in suffering for the good news, relying on God's power.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Therefore do not be ashamed of the testimony about our Lord, nor of me his prisoner, but share in suffering for the good news according to the power of God,

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves salvation/call, denial of works and pretemporal grace.
key_decisions.before: who saved us and called us with a holy calling, not according to our works but according to his own purpose and grace. This grace was given to us in Christ Jesus before eternal times,
key_decisions.after: He saved us and called us with a holy calling, not according to our works but according to his own purpose and grace, given to us in Christ Jesus before eternal times.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: who saved us and called us with a holy calling, not according to our works but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given to us in Christ Jesus before the ages began,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps appearance, death's defeat and illumination of life.
key_decisions.before: but has now been revealed through the appearing of our Savior Christ Jesus, who abolished death and brought life and immortality to light through the good news.
key_decisions.after: This grace has now been revealed through the appearing of our Savior Christ Jesus, who abolished death and brought life and immortality to light through the good news.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: and now has been revealed through the appearing of our Savior Christ Jesus, who abolished death and brought life and immortality to light through the good news,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps suffering, personal trust and the deposit's direction as one plausible reading.
key_decisions.before: This is also why I suffer these things. But I am not ashamed, because I know the one I have trusted, and I am convinced that he is able to guard what I have entrusted to him until that day.
key_decisions.after: That is why I suffer these things. But I am not ashamed, because I know the one I have trusted and am convinced that he is able to guard what I entrusted to him until that day.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For this reason I also suffer these things, but I am not ashamed, for I know the one in whom I have believed, and I am convinced that he is able to guard what has been entrusted to me until that day.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains the sweeping regional claim and both named examples.
key_decisions.before: You know that everyone in Asia has turned away from me, including Phygelus and Hermogenes.
key_decisions.after: You know that everyone in Asia turned away from me, including Phygelus and Hermogenes.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: You know that all who are in Asia turned away from me, among whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes.
